highlights: A new Library page shows every picture and file from your chats, with search and filters.
Agents now use logins that you save in a password manager or the Vault, also after their chat started.
Read replies aloud with ElevenLabs or xAI, dictate with Groq, and add Mistral as a provider.
Agents use fewer tokens on most providers, and OpenBot uses less memory for tabs and idle agents.
Delete the history of a chat or a channel, and open an agent's page as a side panel tab.
